2608.05906.title: Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair
2608.05906.paper_summary: LLM agents that repair failures often discard successful corrections, forcing later episodes to rediscover similar solutions. We study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates. We introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions. Under oracle-assisted benchmark feedback, only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval. A deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type, which conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with identical initial predictions and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from \(66.34\%\) to \(69.79\%\) on Spider and from \(47.35\%\) to \(48.44\%\) on BIRD. Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD. MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark, while Reflexion-style memory reaches \(51.24\%\) on BIRD at substantially higher inference cost. Ablations show that negative memory contributes modestly, the value of type conditioning and lexical--dense ranking is dataset dependent, and schema-local experience provides the most consistent benefit. These results clarify when causal cross-query memory improves repair and when broader memory representations remain preferable.
2608.05906.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人修復失敗時，經常會丟棄成功的修正，迫使後續的情節重新發現類似的解決方案。<lb/>我們研究最終修復結果是否能在不更新參數的情況下改善後續的 Text-to-SQL 情節。<lb/>我們介紹了 MERIT，一種無需訓練的代理人，維護一個在線的雙極性記憶，記錄經過 oracle 驗證的修正和觀察到的失敗方向。<lb/>在 oracle 輔助的基準反饋下，只有來自早期最終情節的記憶可以被檢索。<lb/>一個確定性分類器分配粗略的失敗類型，這會影響混合詞彙-密集檢索器，在凍結的模型生成每次修訂之前。<lb/>使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，具有相同的初始預測和修復預算，MERIT 在 Spider 上將執行準確率從 \(66.34\%\) 提高到 \(69.79\%\)，在 BIRD 上從 \(47.35\%\) 提高到 \(48.44\%\)。<lb/>配對分析為 Spider 的增益提供了明確的證據，但對 BIRD 的證據較弱。<lb/>在任何基準上，MERIT 都無法與未類型化的動態檢索可靠區分，而 Reflexion 風格的記憶在 BIRD 上達到 \(51.24\%\)，但推理成本顯著更高。<lb/>消融實驗顯示，負記憶的貢獻較小，類型條件和詞彙-密集排名的價值依賴於數據集，而模式本地經驗提供了最一致的好處。<lb/>這些結果澄清了何時因果交叉查詢記憶改善修復，以及何時更廣泛的記憶表示仍然更可取。
